answer: The zephyr of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, re-queued for a second panel, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The garden holds work receipts rather than names, so the island of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
